programme.title: Ittefaq
programme.desc: Dilip Roy is a painter by trade and, despite possessing a beautiful wife called Sushma, he spends most of his time painting. On the day of their anniversary celebration, Dilip is late finishing a painting when a frustrated Sushma snatches the brush from his hand. Furious, Dilip strangles her to death, is arrested and sent to a psychiatric institute.

programme.title: Satte Pe Satta
programme.desc: Ravi, the eldest of seven orphaned brothers, living in a farmhouse, marries Indu, a nurse. However, the brothers and their sister-in-law struggle to adjust with each other.

programme.title: Guddi
programme.desc: Kusum is obsessed with Bollywood movies and is unable to distinguish between the real world and the movie world, to the extent that she refuses to marry anyone besides her idol, Dharmendra.

programme.title: Yaraana
programme.desc: JB, a borderline psychopath, is attracted to Lalita, a beautiful, young woman. He forces her to marry him but she runs away on her wedding day by feigning unconsciousness.

programme.title: Karm
programme.desc: Young lovers Arvind and Asha plan to marry, but when Asha's astrologer father predicts that her fiancée will die on their wedding day, the couple decide to sidestep fate and simply live together.
